name: research
description: Vollständiger Datenexport für eigene Forschung/Analyse — inkl. ppi_raw, Firmware, Rohzeitreihen
description_en: Full data export for research/own analysis — incl. ppi_raw, firmware history, raw time series

queries.measurements: SELECT * FROM measurements WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
queries.sessions: SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts_start
queries.session_metrics: SELECT sm.* FROM session_metrics sm JOIN sessions s ON s.id = sm.session_id WHERE s.person = :person AND s.date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to
queries.ppi_raw: SELECT * FROM ppi_raw WHERE person = :person AND date(datetime) BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY datetime
queries.ecg_sessions: SELECT * FROM ecg_sessions WHERE person = :person AND date(datetime) BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to
queries.ecg_samples: SELECT * FROM ecg_samples WHERE session_person = :person ORDER BY session_dt, sample_index
queries.ppi_hrv_advanced: SELECT * FROM ppi_hrv_advanced WHERE date(fenster_start) BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY fenster_start
queries.polar_nightly_hrv: SELECT * FROM polar_nightly_hrv WHERE date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.polar_sleep_hypnogram: SELECT * FROM polar_sleep_hypnogram WHERE date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date, offset_s
queries.polar_sleep_wake: SELECT * FROM polar_sleep_wake WHERE date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date, millis_in_day
queries.oura_sleep_model: SELECT * FROM oura_sleep_model WHERE day BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY day
queries.device_firmware_history: SELECT * FROM device_firmware_history ORDER BY device_id, date_from
queries.persons: SELECT person_id, device_user_id, timezone, active FROM persons WHERE person_id = :person
queries.health_canonical: SELECT * FROM health_canonical WHERE date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date, metric
queries.data_quality_flags: SELECT * FROM data_quality_flags ORDER BY severity, table_name
